name: LaPamela Williams
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 5A

items.text: LaPamela Williams is a realtor who has assisted individuals with healthcare and retirement planning. She grew up in Austin and graduated from Lane Tech. She wants to increase financial accountability in Chicago Public Schools and cut expenses that do not benefit students. She says the board should oversee the budget more responsibly and avoid relying on tax increases. Williams supports opening new charter schools where there is community need, when the groups operating them have sustainable funding and a clear plan to improve learning.
